Merchant Services Specialist

Sydney | Fintech / Payments | Account Management & Merchant Growth

An established Australian payments and fintech business is looking for a Merchant Services Specialist to join its growing commercial team.

This role is focused on managing and growing an existing portfolio of merchant customers, with responsibility for customer engagement, retention, account health and identifying opportunities to increase usage across the portfolio.

It is an ideal opportunity for someone with early-career account management, customer success, inside sales or business development experience who enjoys building relationships and working in a commercial environment.

The Role

You will take ownership of a portfolio of existing merchant customers and act as their key commercial contact.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • managing day-to-day relationships across an existing merchant portfolio
  • conducting regular customer check-ins and account reviews
  • monitoring account activity, engagement and potential churn risks
  • identifying opportunities to increase transaction volume and customer usage
  • supporting retention, upsell and cross-sell activity
  • understanding each merchant’s business and payment requirements
  • onboarding and supporting smaller merchant accounts where required
  • proactively contacting customers rather than operating in a purely reactive service model
  • maintaining accurate customer and pipeline information within the CRM
  • working closely with the broader sales team to ensure larger new-business opportunities remain with the appropriate BDMs
  • helping create a strong and consistent customer experience across the merchant base

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is commercially minded, proactive and confident dealing with customers.

You should be able to demonstrate:

  • experience in account management, customer success, inside sales, business development or another customer-facing B2B role
  • strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • confidence speaking with customers by phone and managing regular outbound activity
  • the ability to manage multiple customer relationships and priorities
  • a proactive approach to retention and account growth
  • comfort working towards KPIs and commercial objectives
  • good organisation and CRM discipline
  • strong problem-solving and customer service capability

Experience within payments, fintech, banking, SaaS, telecommunications or another B2B service environment would be highly regarded, but direct payments experience is not essential.

The Opportunity

This role forms part of a newly strengthened merchant services function designed to give existing customers greater attention while allowing the new-business sales team to remain focused on acquiring new customers.

job.title: Enterprise Sales Manager – Payables
job.description:
Enterprise Sales Manager – Payables

Sydney | Fintech / Payments | Enterprise B2B Sales

An established Australian payments and fintech business is looking for an experienced Enterprise Sales Manager – Payables to help drive the next stage of growth across its B2B payments offering.

This is a hands-on commercial role combining enterprise new-business sales, revenue ownership and small-team leadership.

You will personally pursue larger mid-market and enterprise opportunities while also providing direction to an existing team focused on customer activation and growth.

The Role

You will take commercial ownership of a growing B2B payments portfolio, with a strong focus on acquiring larger customers, increasing payment volumes and driving greater usage across the existing customer base.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • identifying and winning new mid-market and enterprise customers
  • developing a targeted pipeline of larger B2B payment opportunities
  • engaging senior finance stakeholders including CFOs, Financial Controllers and Accounts Payable leaders
  • running discovery and understanding customer payment, cashflow and operational requirements
  • developing tailored commercial solutions and business cases
  • managing complex opportunities from initial engagement through to close
  • driving revenue, payment volume and customer activation
  • identifying opportunities to increase usage across existing customers
  • leading and coaching two existing team members focused on activation and customer growth
  • maintaining strong pipeline, forecasting and CRM discipline
  • working closely with product, operations and other commercial teams

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is still highly capable on the tools and enjoys personally winning business, while also having the maturity to coach and provide commercial direction to a small team.

You should be able to demonstrate:

  • strong B2B new-business sales experience
  • experience selling complex solutions into mid-market or enterprise customers
  • confidence engaging senior finance and commercial decisionmakers
  • a track record of generating and converting your own pipeline
  • strong commercial acumen and consultative selling capability
  • experience managing longer or more complex sales cycles
  • the ability to drive revenue growth beyond the initial customer acquisition
  • strong pipeline and CRM discipline
  • some experience mentoring, coaching or leading others

Experience within payments, fintech, payables, AP automation, banking, treasury or financial technology would be highly regarded.

However, we are also open to strong enterprise sellers from SaaS, technology or other complex B2B solution environments where they have sold into finance-related decisionmakers.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join a business investing heavily in its commercial capability and technology platform.

The role provides genuine ownership across both new customer acquisition and ongoing revenue growth, with the opportunity to influence how the payables business develops as it scales.

Rather than managing a large established sales team, this role suits someone who enjoys being close to customers, personally pursuing larger opportunities and leading from the front.

Location

The role is based in Mascot, Sydney, with a hybrid working environment and regular collaboration with the broader commercial team.

Remuneration

$140,000 – $160,000 base + superannuation + commission

There may be some flexibility for an exceptional candidate with directly relevant enterprise sales experience.

job.title: Enterprise Sales Executive
job.description:
Enterprise Sales Executive

Sydney | Fintech / Payments | Enterprise New Business

An established Australian payments and fintech business is looking for an experienced Enterprise Sales Executive to help drive growth across a range of industry verticals.

This is a genuine new-business hunting role focused on larger and more complex opportunities. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, engaging senior decisionmakers and converting enterprise opportunities from initial contact through to close.

The role will work across multiple verticals and payment solutions, including both established markets and newer growth areas.

The Role

You will focus on winning larger customers and more complex commercial opportunities that sit beyond traditional merchant-by-merchant sales.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • identifying and developing new enterprise opportunities
  • building and managing your own pipeline
  • engaging senior commercial, finance and technology stakeholders
  • running discovery to understand complex customer requirements
  • developing tailored commercial and payment solutions
  • managing longer and more sophisticated sales cycles
  • working with internal product, technical and operational teams where integrations are involved
  • preparing and presenting commercial proposals and business cases
  • negotiating and closing high-value opportunities
  • maintaining strong forecasting, pipeline and CRM discipline
  • supporting growth across multiple industry verticals and distribution partnerships

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a proven enterprise seller who can demonstrate:

  • strong new-business and hunter mentality
  • experience selling complex B2B solutions into enterprise customers
  • a track record of creating and converting your own pipeline
  • confidence engaging senior executives and multiple stakeholders
  • strong consultative selling and commercial capability
  • experience navigating longer and more complex sales cycles
  • strong presentation, negotiation and closing skills
  • the ability to understand and communicate technology-led solutions
  • disciplined CRM and pipeline management

Experience within payments, fintech or financial technology would be highly regarded, but it is not essential.

Strong candidates from SaaS, technology, software platforms or other complex B2B solution environments will also be considered, particularly where they have experience selling into enterprise organisations.

Exposure to APIs, integrations or technology-led sales environments would be advantageous.

The Opportunity

This is a strong opportunity for an enterprise seller who wants genuine ownership of the sales process and the ability to work across a broad range of commercial opportunities.

The business is investing heavily in its commercial capability, technology and AI-enabled sales tools, creating an environment designed to help strong salespeople perform at a high level.

This role suits someone who enjoys creating opportunities from the ground up, working across complex customer requirements and personally driving deals through to close.

Location

The role is based in Mascot, Sydney, with a hybrid working environment and regular customer-facing activity.

Remuneration

$120,000 – $130,000 base + superannuation + commission

There may be some flexibility for an exceptional candidate with directly relevant enterprise sales experience.
